title: IceCream Brain Freeze
description: This DataPack Adds A IceCream Cone It Can Be Used As Food But Also It Can Be Used As An Weapon.
body:
- **This DataPack Adds A IceCream Cone It Can Be Used As Food But Also It Can Be Used As An Weapon.**

To Use The IceCream Right Click With It In Your Offhand Or Mainhand. you will it the ice cream cone, and after like a few seconds there will be a cold burst and this will damage any player or mob near you.

injoy this simple data pack everyone :)

- **functions:**
- icecream_brain_freeze:give/cone
- icecream_brain_freeze:give/icecream_cone
